---
title: "Declare the Native Runtime"
subtitle: "Review Spack requirements before building"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

`spack.yaml` declares the native runtime. R 4.5.1 is retained from the
existing environment. Neovim is retained deliberately as the interactive IDE
for pipeline development. The scientific workflow itself remains
command-line-driven.

The `x86_64_v3` baseline avoids tying the image to the build node. The system
libraries follow the exemplar's R, Quarto, `targets`, and graphics build
baseline; project-specific additions require evidence from reviewed code.

The native layer includes both FlexiBLAS, which Spack's R installation uses,
and OpenBLAS. The latter is an explicit runtime requirement because binary R
packages resolved by `uvr` can link directly to the `libopenblas.so.0` SONAME
instead of going through R's FlexiBLAS interface. Declaring OpenBLAS as a root
spec ensures that its shared libraries are linked into the final Spack view.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Runtime Policy"}

Before building, review the R, Neovim, Rocky Linux, Spack, and CPU target
versions below. None of these choices are inferred from protected data.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-config-yaml file="{{ emit.project_root }}/spack.yaml" title="Emit The Runtime Declaration"}

```yaml
spack:
  specs:
  - r@4.5.1
  - libxml2
  - icu4c
  - libx11
  - git
  - curl
  - openssl
  - libgit2
  - cmake
  - gmake
  - freetype
  - libjpeg-turbo
  - libpng
  - libtiff
  - libwebp
  - fontconfig
  - fribidi
  - harfbuzz
  - libuv
  - glpk
  - flexiblas
  - openblas
  view: true
  concretizer:
    unify: true
  packages:
    all:
      require:
      - target=x86_64_v3
  config:
    template_dirs:
    - $env/containers/templates
    - $spack/share/spack/templates
  container:
    format: singularity
    images:
      os: rockylinux:9
      spack: 1.2.0
    template: MDGHealthshedClinicData.def.j2
    os_packages:
      final:
      - ca-certificates
      - findutils
      - gzip
      - tar
      - which
      - gcc
      - gcc-c++
      - make
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Declaration"}

```sh
rg -n 'r@4.5.1|neovim|flexiblas|openblas|target=x86_64_v3|rockylinux:9' spack.yaml
```

:::
